conditions: The assertion concerns abstract XDM values and the XQuery 3.1 interpretation of arrays.
limitations: These value distinctions do not prescribe the physical layout of a sequence, a serialization format, or the members of every array.

triggers: W3C source correction or erratum, spec byte drift, or material contrary scoped evidence.

statement: In the XQuery 3.1 data model, a value is an ordered sequence of zero or more items. An item is identical to a singleton sequence containing it, and sequences have no nested sequences. An array is an item and can itself be an item of a sequence.
